_doc: Canonical trade identity and availability metadata. Temporary wage compatibility values still come from data/prices.json, which is scheduled for deletion; adding or describing a trade must never require editing it.

chemist.note: Does not exist yet; you must create this trade.

electrician.note: Does not exist. Cannot exist until Module 50 does.

engineer.note: Does not exist as a paid civilian profession. A developed state may keep military and hydraulic engineers under its own employ; a private one is your invention.

engraver.note: Die and seal cutter. Skilled ones already exist wherever there is a minting or sealing tradition; they become your punchcutters.

machinist.note: Does not exist yet; you must create this trade.

mason.note: Abundant and good wherever there is a serious stone-building tradition; scarcer and dearer where building is mostly wood.

merchant.note: Agent and factor, paid on commission in practice.

millwright.note: Water-mill builder. Scarce wherever milling by water is already established; the scarcest useful trade you can hire.

optician.note: Does not exist yet. You must create this trade from glassworkers.

plumber.note: Lead worker. Skilled and numerous wherever lead pipe-making is already an established trade (Roman plumbarii are the best-attested case); scarce or nonexistent elsewhere.
